description: Accepting twin of n81 and n82: payload_text {"\ud842\udfb7":"\ud842\udfb7"}, U+20BB7 written as a surrogate-pair escape, as a name and as a value. A paired escape is one code point (RFC 7493 section 2.1: "\uD800\uDEAD" is legal), and the canonical form writes it as is: {"𠮷":"𠮷"}. An engine that rejects every surrogate escape, rather than an unpaired one, fails here.
